chunks: And God knows what you hide and what you disclose.
ai.seo_question: What does God know about human beings according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nahl underscores the concept of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (Knowledge of the Unseen) as a divine attribute, highlighting that God’s awareness transcends the duality of apparent and hidden states. It serves as a spiritual anchor for believers, encouraging sincerity (ikhlas) by reminding them that internal intentions are as visible to God as external actions, a theme deeply explored in the traditions of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding the purity of the heart.
